document.about: Federal Reserve Beige Book, December 2024. Each district's report opens on a page titled in two lines beside the district's map, and the district's name runs over its right-hand pages.

notes: 2026-11-25 (#276): the map's towns, small drawn dots, stood level with the title's lines and were taken as their bullets. `Federal Reserve Bank of` / `New York` read as two items, then a paragraph and a heading, and the district's level-1 heading came only from its running copy on the page after. With that copy read as running (#319), New York's sections nested under Boston. A drawing's dots crowd one another; a list's bullets stand a line apart.

checks.issue: #276: the title's first line was a paragraph of its own.
#276: the title's second line was an h2 of its own. (`New York` heads the National Summary's paragraph on the district once, on page 5.)
